description_en: Deletes a notification configuration for Auto Scaling events and resource changes
description_zh: 删除一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知
name: DeleteNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the notification recipient. The parameter formats for different notification methods are as follows:

CloudMonitor: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
MNS queue: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

Variables in the parameter formats:

region-id: the ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，各通知方式的参数格式如下：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：

region-id：伸缩组所属的地域ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs
parameters.name: region_id
